verdict.rationale: The RTX 5080 product page names NVIDIA Project G-Assist, an AI assistant powered by the RTX PC that helps users tune, control, and optimize their system, so some task delegation to a first-party assistant is documented. The evidence is a single marketing sentence, and the "Project" label suggests it may be experimental. missing for 10: documentation of which tasks can be delegated and how the assistant executes them, evidence that it ships as part of the product rather than as separate software, maturity or availability status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is an AI assistant powered by your GeForce RTX PC that helps you tune, control, and optimize your system.
